info.title: net10-check: what blocks this solution from moving to .NET 10?
info.description: Scans a .NET solution and tells you in seconds what blocks the move to .NET 10: target frameworks reaching end of support on 2026-11-10, NuGet packages to update (deprecated, vulnerable, without .NET 10 support) and a curated list of .NET 10 breaking changes found in your code and project files.

options.name: --output
options.description: write the md/json report to a file (console summary still printed)

options.name: --fail-on-eol
options.description: exit code 1 if any project targets a framework out of support by 2026-11-10 (for CI)
